title: USBRAIN Build Manifest
description: Root contract generated by the USBRAIN Builder and consumed first by the USBRAIN Runtime.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this build manifest contract.

build_id.description: Unique identifier of the generated USBRAIN build.

build_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp indicating when the build was generated.

builder_version.description: Version of the USBRAIN Builder that generated the build.

runtime_version_min.description: Minimum runtime version expected to consume this build manifest.

target_os_family.description: Operating system families supported by this generated USBRAIN build.

build_mode.description: Primary build mode selected during Builder generation.

languages.description: Languages enabled for this USBRAIN build.

catalog_snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the model catalog snapshot used during build planning.

hub_snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the Hub snapshot used during build planning.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes about this build.

created_by.description: Optional creator label for this build.

relativeManifestRef.description: Relative path from the USBRAIN root to another contract file.

languageCode.description: IETF-style language tag supported by the build.

targetDeviceProfile.description: Summary of the removable device targeted by the Builder.

label.description: Human-readable device label shown by the Builder.

capacity_gb.description: Usable capacity in gigabytes estimated during planning.

filesystem.description: Filesystem observed or chosen for the target device.

removable.description: Whether the Builder observed this target as a removable device.
